testCase.input: I couldn't run the full gate inside the sandbox: App tests need `com.apple.testmanagerd.control`, which the sandbox blocks. Package build, formatting and 201 package tests passed, 8 skipped. Please run `scripts/gate` outside the sandbox to cover the App tests.
